# generate-websocket — WebSocket/AsyncAPI 3.0 Schema Generation Skill

Generate AsyncAPI 3.0 YAML specifications for WebSocket protocols using the
`WebSocketGenerator` class. Produce channel-based messaging schemas with typed
message envelopes, connection lifecycle management, heartbeat, and subprotocols.

## Generator Interface

```
Module  : src/uptempo/schema/websocket.py
Class   : WebSocketGenerator(SchemaGenerator)
Methods :
  generate(issue: Issue, workspace: Path) -> list[Path]
  validate(files: list[Path]) -> list[str]
Base    : src/uptempo/schema/base.py — SchemaGenerator
```

## Input

| Field | Source | Description |
|-------|--------|-------------|
| `issue.identifier` | Linear | Issue ID (e.g., `UPT-73`) — embedded in header comment |
| `issue.title` | Linear | Short summary — becomes `info.title` seed |
| `issue.description` | Linear | Full requirements — parse for channels, message types |
| `workspace` | Orchestrator | Absolute path to `./workspaces/{issue_id}/` |

## Output

```
{workspace}/
└── websocket/
    ├── {domain}-ws.yaml         # Primary AsyncAPI 3.0 spec
    ├── components/
    │   ├── messages.yaml        # Reusable message definitions
    │   └── schemas.yaml         # Payload schemas
    └── .asyncapi-lint.yaml      # Lint config (if absent)
```

All files include the standard header:

```yaml
# Generated by Uptempo for UPT-73: Collaborative Editor WebSocket
```

## Procedure

### Step 1 — Parse Requirements

1. Extract channel names from `issue.description` (e.g., "chat room", "editor session").
2. Identify message types per channel: client→server and server→client.
3. Detect subprotocol needs: versioning (`v1.editor`), format (`json`, `protobuf`).
4. Note connection lifecycle: auth handshake, heartbeat interval, close reasons.
5. Identify streaming patterns: pub/sub, request/reply, broadcast, presence.

### Step 2 — Initialize Workspace

```python
from uptempo.schema.websocket import WebSocketGenerator

generator = WebSocketGenerator()
out_dir = workspace / "websocket"
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

### Step 3 — Build AsyncAPI Root Document

```yaml
asyncapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: "{Domain} WebSocket API"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Generated from Linear issue {issue.identifier}"
servers:
  production:
    host: "api.example.com"
    protocol: ws
    protocolVersion: "13"
    security:
      - $ref: '#/components/securitySchemes/bearerAuth'
    bindings:
      ws:
        method: GET
        headers:
          type: object
          properties:
            Authorization:
              type: string
channels: {}
operations: {}
components:
  messages: {}
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
```

### Step 4 — Define Message Envelope

All WebSocket messages use a consistent JSON envelope:

```yaml
components:
  schemas:
    MessageEnvelope:
      type: object
      required: [type, id, timestamp]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          description: "Discriminator for message routing"
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: "Unique message ID for ack/dedup"
        payload:
          description: "Message-specific data"
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        correlationId:
          type: string
          description: "Links request to response"
```

### Step 5 — Generate Channels and Operations

Map each feature to a channel with send/receive operations:

```yaml
channels:
  chat:
    address: /ws/chat/{roomId}
    parameters:
      roomId:
        description: "Chat room identifier"
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    messages:
      sendMessage:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/SendMessage'
      messageReceived:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/MessageReceived'
      userJoined:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/UserJoined'
      userLeft:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/UserLeft'
    bindings:
      ws:
        method: GET
        headers:
          type: object
          properties:
            Authorization:
              type: string

operations:
  sendChatMessage:
    action: send
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/chat'
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/chat/messages/sendMessage'
  receiveChatMessage:
    action: receive
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/chat'
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/chat/messages/messageReceived'
      - $ref: '#/channels/chat/messages/userJoined'
      - $ref: '#/channels/chat/messages/userLeft'
```

### Step 6 — Define Message Schemas

Create typed messages using the envelope pattern:

```yaml
components:
  messages:
    SendMessage:
      name: sendMessage
      title: "Send Chat Message"
      contentType: application/json
      payload:
        allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/MessageEnvelope'
          - type: object
            properties:
              type:
                const: "chat.send"
              payload:
                type: object
                required: [text]
                properties:
                  text: { type: string, maxLength: 4096 }
                  replyTo: { type: string, format: uuid }

    MessageReceived:
      name: messageReceived
      title: "Chat Message Received"
      contentType: application/json
      payload:
        allOf:
          - $ref: '#/components/schemas/MessageEnvelope'
          - type: object
            properties:
              type:
                const: "chat.message"
              payload:
                type: object
                properties:
                  text: { type: string }
                  sender: { $ref: '#/components/schemas/UserRef' }
```

### Step 7 — Add Connection Lifecycle

Define heartbeat, authentication, and close semantics:

```yaml
x-ws-lifecycle:
  authentication:
    method: "first-message"
    schema:
      type: object
      required: [type, token]
      properties:
        type: { const: "auth" }
        token: { type: string }
    timeout_ms: 5000
    failure_close_code: 4001

  heartbeat:
    interval_ms: 30000
    timeout_ms: 10000
    client_ping:
      type: object
      properties:
        type: { const: "ping" }
        timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }
    server_pong:
      type: object
      properties:
        type: { const: "pong" }
        timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }

  close_codes:
    1000: "Normal closure"
    1001: "Going away"
    4000: "Invalid message format"
    4001: "Authentication failed"
    4002: "Authorization denied"
    4003: "Rate limit exceeded"
    4004: "Channel not found"
    4008: "Heartbeat timeout"

  reconnection:
    strategy: "exponential-backoff"
    initial_delay_ms: 1000
    max_delay_ms: 30000
    max_attempts: 10
    jitter: true
```

### Step 8 — Add Subprotocol Definition

```yaml
x-ws-subprotocols:
  - name: "v1.{domain}.json"
    contentType: "application/json"
    description: "JSON-encoded messages with envelope pattern"
  - name: "v1.{domain}.protobuf"
    contentType: "application/protobuf"
    description: "Protobuf-encoded messages for high-throughput"
```

### Step 9 — Write Files

```python
files = generator.generate(issue, workspace)
```

### Step 10 — Validate

```python
errors = generator.validate(files)
# Runs asyncapi validate against each file
```

## Output Template

Minimal valid WebSocket spec:

```yaml
asyncapi: "3.0.0"
info:
  title: "Notifications WebSocket"
  version: "1.0.0"
  description: "Generated from Linear issue UPT-73"
servers:
  production:
    host: "api.example.com"
    protocol: ws
    protocolVersion: "13"
channels:
  notifications:
    address: /ws/notifications
    messages:
      subscribe:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/Subscribe'
      notification:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/Notification'
      ack:
        $ref: '#/components/messages/Ack'
operations:
  subscribeToNotifications:
    action: send
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/notifications'
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/notifications/messages/subscribe'
  receiveNotification:
    action: receive
    channel:
      $ref: '#/channels/notifications'
    messages:
      - $ref: '#/channels/notifications/messages/notification'
components:
  messages:
    Subscribe:
      name: subscribe
      contentType: application/json
      payload:
        type: object
        required: [type, topics]
        properties:
          type: { const: "subscribe" }
          topics:
            type: array
            items: { type: string }
    Notification:
      name: notification
      contentType: application/json
      payload:
        type: object
        required: [type, id, payload, timestamp]
        properties:
          type: { const: "notification" }
          id: { type: string, format: uuid }
          payload:
            type: object
            properties:
              title: { type: string }
              body: { type: string }
              severity: { type: string, enum: [info, warn, error] }
          timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }
    Ack:
      name: ack
      contentType: application/json
      payload:
        type: object
        properties:
          type: { const: "ack" }
          messageId: { type: string, format: uuid }
  schemas:
    MessageEnvelope:
      type: object
      required: [type, id, timestamp]
      properties:
        type: { type: string }
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        payload: {}
        timestamp: { type: string, format: date-time }
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
x-ws-lifecycle:
  heartbeat:
    interval_ms: 30000
    timeout_ms: 10000
  close_codes:
    1000: "Normal closure"
    4001: "Authentication failed"
    4008: "Heartbeat timeout"
  reconnection:
    strategy: "exponential-backoff"
    initial_delay_ms: 1000
    max_delay_ms: 30000
    max_attempts: 10
```

## Validation Rules

| Rule | Tool | Severity |
|------|------|----------|
| Valid AsyncAPI 3.0 structure | `asyncapi validate` | error |
| `protocol: ws` on server definitions | asyncapi lint | error |
| All messages have `contentType` | asyncapi lint | error |
| Message envelope has `type` discriminator | custom `uptempo-ws-envelope` | error |
| Heartbeat defined in `x-ws-lifecycle` | custom `uptempo-ws-heartbeat` | warn |
| Close codes documented | custom `uptempo-ws-close-codes` | warn |
| Channel address starts with `/ws/` | custom `uptempo-ws-path` | warn |
| Each channel has send and receive operations | custom `uptempo-ws-bidirectional` | warn |
| Header comment present | `_header_comment()` check | error |

Run validation:

```bash
npx @asyncapi/cli validate {workspace}/websocket/*.yaml
```

## Error Handling

| Condition | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| No channels found in issue | Generate generic `notifications` channel with `x-generated: placeholder` |
| One-way push only (no client messages) | Log warning, recommend SSE, still generate WebSocket with subscribe-only |
| Missing auth requirement | Default to first-message auth pattern with `x-auth-inferred: true` |
| No heartbeat specified | Apply defaults: ping every 30s, timeout after 10s |
| Message payload unclear | Infer from channel name, mark with `x-inferred: true` |
| Subprotocol not specified | Default to `v1.{domain}.json` |
| asyncapi validate failure | Return errors from `validate()`, do not delete generated files |
| Workspace directory missing | Create `websocket/` directory tree automatically |
